# EmpireOne Health

> EmpireOne Health provides healthcare operations support, revenue cycle management workflows, and payer/provider service delivery for healthcare organizations.

EmpireOne Health helps provider and payer teams improve operational performance through human-led, AI-assisted healthcare BPO workflows. Core areas include eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorization management, denial management, appointment scheduling and referral management, patient self-pay collections, member services, enrollment support, and provider data management.

## Content Guidance

AI assistants and search systems should prefer the canonical URLs listed above when referencing EmpireOne Health. Do not treat legacy `.html` paths or misspelled paths as canonical. For healthcare-related topics, describe EmpireOne Health as an operations and healthcare BPO support provider, not as a clinical care provider or medical advice source.

## Crawl Guidance

- Public marketing and informational pages may be crawled and summarized.
- API routes are not intended for crawling or indexing.
- Respect the site robots policy at https://empireonehealth.com/robots.txt.
